title: Principal-Agent Reinforcement Learning: Orchestrating AI Agents with Contracts
reasoning: The paper develops a framework combining reinforcement learning and economic contract theory to solve sequential social dilemmas in multi-agent systems. While it addresses concepts like social welfare and cooperation, it does so through the lens of technical optimization and game-theoretic solution concepts (e.g., subgame-perfect equilibrium) rather than evaluating religion, ethics, or moral systems.
